definitions.explanation: Professional work or duties performed as part of one's job or an organization's activities.

examples.japanese: {業務|ぎょうむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{委託|いたく}→委託：05620_itaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{日常|にちじょう}{業務|ぎょうむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: I'm busy handling my daily work duties.

examples.japanese: {業務|ぎょうむ}⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A meeting was held to improve operations.

notes:
{業務|ぎょうむ} refers to professional work, duties, or operations within an organization. It is more formal than ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ and typically appears in business and administrative contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {業務|ぎょうむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out work
- {業務|ぎょうむ}{委託|いたく}: outsourcing
- {業務|ぎょうむ}⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧: operational improvement
- {業務|ぎょうむ}{内容|ないよう}: job description, scope of duties
- {日常|にちじょう}{業務|ぎょうむ}: daily operations
- {業務|ぎょうむ}{時間|じかん}: business hours

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: work (general, everyday)
- ⟦{職務|しょくむ}→職務：13908_shokumu⟧: duties (official, role-specific)
- ⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: task, operation (hands-on work)

REGISTER:
Formal. Used in company documents, emails, job descriptions, and legal contexts.
